scripts.db:dev:seed:pg: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec -T postgres psql -U soquel -d soquel_dev -f /seeds/postgres.sql
scripts.db:dev:seed:mysql: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec -T mysql sh -c 'mysql -usoquel -psoquel soquel_dev < /seeds/mysql.sql'
scripts.db:dev:seed:redis: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec -T redis sh /seeds/redis.sh
scripts.db:dev:seed:mongo: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec -T mongo mongosh --quiet -u soquel -p soquel --authenticationDatabase admin /seeds/mongo.js
